review_input.original_instruction: For your start point you are facing a wooden garden arbor turn around so that you can see the rows of white chairs to your right and left. And move forward through the center aisle. Once you are at the end of the aisle  you will need to make a right turn towards the column that's to the right. And from that column that is supporting the balcony above you will see a bench, a black iron bench. You will need to make your way to the second black iron bench that is directly opposite and hop over the bench. you will see there's an open doorway. Move forward to the left and enter that doorway. And move one step inside it looks like a dining room or a banquet hall. Turn to the left you will move in front of a column and you will also see there's a banquet table to your left and one to the right closet to the flat screen TV on the wall. You will need to move in between both tables.

subtasks: For your start point, you are facing a wooden garden arbor. Turn around so that you can see the rows of white chairs to your right and left. Move forward through the center aisle. Once you are at the end of the aisle, make a right turn towards the column to the right. From that column supporting the balcony above, you will see a black iron bench. Make your way to the second black iron bench directly opposite and hop over the bench. You will see an open doorway.

Move forward to the left and enter that doorway. Move one step inside; it looks like a dining room or a banquet hall. Turn to the left. You will move in front of a column and see a banquet table to your left and one to your right, closest to the flat-screen TV on the wall. Move in between both tables.

handoffs.handoff_rationale: The source says the doorway becomes visible after the hop, then separately commands moving toward and entering it. The handoff must not upgrade visibility into arrival.

next_entry.text: From the post-hop state, move toward and enter the visible doorway.

preceding_exit.text: Complete the hop over the selected second black iron bench; seeing the doorway does not mean it has been reached.

shared_context.text: The selected second black iron bench has been hopped over.
The open doorway is visible but has not yet been reached; stage 2 must still approach and enter it.

layer_checks.conclusion: No rendered_instruction was supplied in this template example, so lexical candidate-versus-rendered comparison is not assessable. The candidate text itself is reviewed.
Each meaningful source event is grouped at event/sentence level and linked to the actual candidate stage(s); no noun-only evidence is treated as action coverage.
Checked ordering, triggers, reference frames, counts, late descriptions, branches and repeated visits.
Independently checked actual English for entry, target, complete ordered process, semantically correct ending type and scoped conditions. Generator audit fields are not accepted as proof.
Compared the actual preceding completion with the next stage entry. A landmark cue/observation is not treated as arrival at a later doorway or region.
Checked weak cuts and buried independent goals against supported boundaries.
Cross-checked L1 source coverage, L3 stage semantics and L4 handoff evidence; each event keeps the same meaning across all three layers.
